notes: True homograph of the existing H5532 ("be of use; cherish"), identical spelling and pointing (סָכַן) -- added as סכן² (higher Strong's number) per the ascending-Strong's-number superscript convention; H5532 is retroactively renamed סכן¹ in this same batch.

Pual "be impoverished" (requested with a confirm-if-attested flag) is genuinely attested: Isa.40.20, הַמְסֻכָּן, "he who is impoverished [and can afford no such offering] chooses wood that will not rot".
